subject: Music Production
title: Danger Mouse's Mashup Breakthrough
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Danger Mouse's Mashup Breakthrough.

hook.text: In 2004, Brian Burton mixed the Beatles' White Album with Jay-Z's Black Album in his bedroom.

buildup.text: He released 'The Grey Album' for free online, and it spread across the internet within hours.

discovery.text: The mashup proved that combining existing works could create something entirely new and compelling.

twist.text: EMI sent legal threats to block the album, but the publicity only made Danger Mouse more famous.

climax.text: He went on to produce Gorillaz, The Black Keys, and Adele, becoming a top-tier studio force.

punchline.text: An illegal mashup launched one of music's top producers.

quiz.question: What two albums did Danger Mouse combine for The Grey Album?
options: The Beatles' White Album and Jay-Z's Black Album
Led Zeppelin IV and The Blueprint
